PRICING

Services and pricing

Most services are quoted at a fixed price. You receive the price before work begins, and it does not change. If the work takes longer than estimated, the price remains the same.

Some work cannot be defined in advance, such as diagnosing a problem with no clear cause. That work is billed at $75 per hour, and we will confirm with you before hourly billing begins.

TERMS

Payment terms

Work quoted above $300 requires a 60 percent deposit before work begins, a further 20 percent at the midpoint stated in your quote, and the final 20 percent on completion. Work quoted at $300 or less is paid on completion. Any deposit is stated in the quote, so you see it before you agree to the work.

Troubleshooting is billed differently, because the cause of the problem is not known at the start. That work is billed hourly with no deposit, and we will confirm with you before billing begins. If we cannot resolve the issue, you pay only for the diagnostic time, and we will refer you to someone who can.

If we quote a fixed price and are unable to complete the work, your deposit is refunded in full. Fixed prices are quoted only for work we are confident we can complete.

Accepted payment methods are cash, check, Zelle, PayPal, and Apple Pay.

QUESTIONS

Frequently asked questions

Is service provided on site or remotely?

Both. On-site service is available across Northern Virginia, and remote support covers any work that does not require physical access to the equipment. Once you describe the issue, we will recommend the appropriate approach.

What are the business hours?

Monday through Friday, 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. Eastern. Evenings and weekends are available by appointment. You have a single point of contact and a response time stated in writing, with no support queue.

How is pricing determined?

Most services are listed on this page with a fixed price, and that price does not change once work begins. Work that cannot be defined in advance, such as diagnosing a problem with no clear cause, is billed at $75 per hour. We will confirm with you before hourly billing begins.

What happens if the work takes longer than quoted?

The price does not change. It is agreed before work begins and is not increased if the work proves more complex than estimated. If the work takes less time than estimated, the price is reduced accordingly.

Is hardware repair offered?

Component-level repair, such as soldering, screen replacement, and board-level work, is not offered. Software services are covered, including data recovery, disk imaging, operating system reinstallation, and migration to working hardware. If a device requires physical repair, we will refer you to a qualified repair shop.

Which operating systems and devices are supported?

Windows, macOS, and Linux are supported, along with tablets, phones, printers, routers, and most equipment found in a home or small office.

Who owns the domains and accounts that are set up?

You own them from the start. Domains, hosting, email, and third-party accounts are registered in your name. We hold administrative access only and return it whenever you request it. Nothing is set up in a way that makes it difficult to change providers.

Is Mizan Group insured?

Yes. Mizan Group LLC is insured through Hiscox for general and professional liability. A certificate of insurance is available on request.

What if you are not sure which service you need?

Describe the issue, and we will explain what is required to resolve it. If a less expensive option would serve you better, we will recommend it. If your request falls outside the services we provide, we will let you know.

How and when is payment due?

Accepted payment methods are cash, check, Zelle, PayPal, and Apple Pay. Work quoted above $300 requires a 60 percent deposit before work begins, a further 20 percent at the midpoint stated in your quote, and the final 20 percent on completion. Work quoted at $300 or less is paid on completion. Hourly troubleshooting requires no deposit. If we quote a fixed price and are unable to complete the work, your deposit is refunded in full.
